description: How to try or connect HelloBooks from an AI agent or integration. Returns two paths: the no-auth public MCP (agents.hellobooks.ai/mcp — read-only product knowledge, works today) and the OAuth company API (developer.hellobooks.ai, with an India sandbox and the authenticated MCP at mcp.hellobooks.ai for a customer’s own books). Pass `surface` (public-mcp / company-api / both) to scope the answer. Use this when a developer or agent asks "how do I try this?", "is there a sandbox?", or "how do I connect my books?".

surface.description: Which path to return: the no-auth public MCP, the OAuth company API, or both (default).

name: get_sandbox_info
